hero.headlinePlain: I build storefronts and the tools that run behind them.
hero.subheadline: Shopify, WordPress, and React work for clients in the US, Australia, Belgium, and South Africa.
hero.supportLine: Four years of shipped client work — catalogs with a million parts in them, custom Liquid themes, and internal apps that replaced somebody's spreadsheet. Thirteen of those builds are below, most of them live right now.

about.heading: About
paragraphs: I'm Celso. I've spent the last four years building and maintaining e-commerce sites and internal tools for businesses that actually depend on them — a US event-linens retailer mid-way through a full theme migration, an HVAC parts distributor moving a million SKUs, an Australian fragrance brand, a South African homeware chain, a Dutch-language course platform.

Most of my work sits in two buckets. Storefronts: Shopify themes in Liquid, WordPress builds in PHP, catalog structure, search, and the checkout details that decide whether a cart converts. And internal tools: React and TypeScript apps that take a repetitive manual process and turn it into a form, a queue, and a database row.
I work directly with the person who owns the problem. No account manager in the middle. I'd rather ask three blunt questions up front than guess at a spec and rebuild it twice.

projects.heading: Selected work
projects.intro: Client sites and tools I've built, rebuilt, and maintained. Links go straight to the live version.

items.title: Building Controls & Solutions
items.hook: A million-part HVAC catalog that contractors can actually search
items.description: Worked on the Shopify storefront for a national HVAC and building-automation distributor carrying 300+ suppliers and 1 million+ parts across 15 US locations. The hard part is navigation and search at that scale: I built out browsable product categories with type filtering, stock and pricing states, and account-based pricing so trade buyers see their tier. Layout is Tailwind on top of Liquid, with API integrations feeding inventory and location data.
items.imageAlt: Building Controls & Solutions HVAC parts Shopify storefront

items.title: CV Linens
items.hook: Store features built to survive a full theme migration
items.description: This store is moving off the legacy Dawn theme onto a new Dwell/Horizon theme, and the usual cost of that is rebuilding every custom feature by hand. I build the features as Shopify app theme extensions instead — app blocks and app embeds that carry their own logic, UI, CSS, and JS — so they're theme-independent and come through the migration without rework. The working standard is blunt: a feature that lands automatically in the new theme is ideal, one or two migration steps is acceptable, anything needing repeated manual work per feature gets rejected. Modular sections and snippets are the fallback, direct theme edits the last resort, and CSS stays scoped per feature rather than global. Also handling ADA/WCAG accessibility remediation across the store.
items.role: Shopify app extension development, theme migration engineering, accessibility remediation
items.imageAlt: CV Linens event linens Shopify store

items.title: GEM (Green Energy Management)
items.hook: Corporate WordPress build for a port energy firm
items.description: Built the corporate site for a renewable energy company working on Caribbean port infrastructure. Dense technical service lines — shore-to-ship power, waste-to-energy, grid integration — had to become service cards and detail pages a port authority can skim, plus a project gallery template where each entry carries its own capacity spec. Custom WordPress theme work in PHP, with consultation CTAs routed through the site and an on-page SEO pass across every service page.
items.role: Custom WordPress theme, template build, SEO
items.imageAlt: GEM Green Energy Management renewable energy WordPress site

items.title: Solitude Labs
items.hook: Zero-trust security, made legible to non-engineers
items.description: Site build for a cybersecurity company working on zero-trust and decentralized protection for grid and industrial systems. The brief was to explain edge security to procurement people without dumbing it down for the engineers also reading it, so the pages are layered: plain-language positioning up top, technical depth one click below. Custom WordPress theme in PHP with hand-written CSS and structured metadata across the stack.
items.role: Custom WordPress theme, page build, SEO

items.title: AI Dashboard App
items.hook: Four internal AI tools behind one dashboard
items.description: A React dashboard that pulls a set of scattered one-off AI tools into a single interface — dealer applications, email generation, logo creation, and domain generation. I built the shared shell, routing, and state so each tool plugs in as a module instead of living as its own app, then implemented the AI calls and merged the domain generator in on its own branch. Dark UI, Tailwind, deployed on Vercel.
items.imageAlt: AI Dashboard App, a React interface for four internal AI tools

items.title: Domain Generator
items.hook: Turns competitor naming patterns into buyable domains
items.description: Naming a high-ticket dropshipping store usually means an afternoon of guessing at a registrar. I built a React tool that reads competitor names in a niche, pulls out the naming patterns they share, and generates candidate domains from those patterns instead of from a thesaurus. API integrations handle the generation and lookup; the whole thing runs serverless on Vercel.
items.role: Solo build — front end, API layer, deployment
items.imageAlt: Domain Generator, a React tool for generating store domain names

items.title: Legal Policy Generator
items.hook: Store policies in a wizard instead of a copy-paste job
items.description: New store owners paste their policy pages from whatever they can find and end up with the wrong company name in the terms of service. This is a multi-step form wizard that walks a merchant through shipping, payment, returns, and terms, then assembles clean policy documents from their answers. Built in React and TypeScript on Vite, with per-step validation and state that survives navigating backwards.
items.role: Solo build — form architecture, document generation, UI
items.imageAlt: Legal Policy Generator, a React wizard for store policy pages

items.title: TinEli Wedding Site
items.hook: One-page invite with a live countdown, built in React
items.description: A single-page wedding site built to be opened on a phone, at a bus stop, once. I built it in React and TypeScript with a live countdown driven off the ceremony timestamp, a typographic layout using custom loaded fonts, and a responsive scheme that holds its proportions from a 360px phone up to a desktop. No CMS, no framework overhead — it loads and it stays loaded.
items.role: Solo build — design and front end
items.imageAlt: TinEli wedding site built in React with a live countdown

items.title: Perfectly Sustainable
items.hook: Content site for sustainable living, structured to be found
items.description: WordPress build for a publisher covering sustainable living, eco-friendly products, farming, and renewable energy. The problem was breadth: four unrelated topic areas competing for the same navigation. I implemented a category and taxonomy structure that keeps each topic browsable on its own, then built the templates and on-page SEO around it so articles rank against their own keywords instead of each other.
items.imageAlt: Perfectly Sustainable, a WordPress content site on sustainable living

items.title: Light + Glo Designs
items.hook: Shopify build for an Australian luxury fragrance brand
items.description: Shopify Liquid work for a Melbourne fragrance house selling soy candles, diffusers, room sprays, and eau de parfum. Fragrance is bought by feel, so the merchandising lets people shop three ways at once — by collection, by aroma profile, and by mood — on top of a catalog with multiple vessel sizes per product. I implemented those collection templates along with the gift set and discovery set pages, the wholesale stockist path, and the on-page SEO.
items.role: Shopify theme development, collection templates, SEO
items.imageAlt: Light + Glo Designs Shopify store for an Australian fragrance brand

items.title: Linguista Academy
items.hook: Dutch-language course platform with paid enrolment
items.description: Built the WordPress platform for a Belgian masterclass on course design, running entirely in Dutch. The site has to sell before it teaches, so I built a long-form landing page — problem framing, method story, deliverables breakdown, testimonials, an expandable FAQ — that runs into paid enrolment and time-limited course access. Behind it sits the module structure, community area, and 1-on-1 feedback booking.
items.role: WordPress build, sales page, enrolment flow
items.imageAlt: Linguista Academy Dutch-language WordPress course platform

items.title: Present Rentals Jax
items.hook: Rental site built for gig drivers applying from a phone
items.description: WordPress site for a Jacksonville company renting DoorDash-ready cars by the week to gig drivers. The audience applies on a phone between shifts, so the page is built around a short path to the application: three-step how-it-works, benefit cards, driver testimonials, then a mobile-first booking flow that hands off cleanly to the application form. Custom theme work in PHP with local SEO for the Jacksonville market.
items.role: WordPress build, landing page development, local SEO
items.imageAlt: Present Rentals Jax WordPress car rental site for gig drivers

items.title: Basix Plastics
items.hook: High-SKU homeware store with rewards and two branches
items.description: Shopify build for a South African homeware retailer selling low-price, high-volume household goods across eight categories, from food storage to garden and personal care. With a basket that's often twenty cheap items, I built the catalog and collection templates for fast browsing and quick add-to-cart, and implemented the storefront side of the 3%-back rewards programme and the free-delivery threshold. Store pages and hours for both Pietermaritzburg branches sit alongside the online catalog.
items.role: Shopify theme development, catalog templates, rewards implementation
items.imageAlt: Basix Plastics Shopify store for a South African homeware retailer
